items.quote: Several respondents noted that Karin took ownership of capability building for new hires and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Karin managed change management after the merger of two units for their unit.
Peers observed that Karin spearheaded cost savings across procurement at the national level.
Several respondents noted that Karin handled analytics to guide resource allocation competently within their team.
Direct reports said that Karin Thalberly assisted with the settlement of a long-running contract dispute.
Peers observed that Karin spearheaded long-term strategy for the sector at the national level.
Direct reports said that Karin took ownership of policy options for the cabinet paper on ageing and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Karin championed the move of paper-based permit applications to an online portal and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Karin spearheaded tracing how a delay in one agency rippled through to others at the national level.
